initial_candidate: LOOKUP then FILTER(until0,ALL) then TRACE_STATE then CHECK
revision: Remove premature time0 restriction and reconnect TRACE_STATE directly to LOOKUP; revision supplied by Codex before outcomes.

data.exposure: Already open/consumed development data; counterexamples and aggregate feedback remain development evidence.
data.independent_truth: Latent data.oracle outside deployed runtime, then scoring.score outside runtime; shared generator grammar/semantics remain common-mode limitations.

acceptance: All fixed DEV cases semantic exact and no operational failure; initial flawed candidate needs at least one valid semantic counterexample and supplied revision must pass before freezing demonstration snapshot. Operational failures alone cannot falsify a graph.
runtime_boundary: runner.execute_case/worker_request sends only public case and immutable typed graph snapshot through runtime_worker. Gold, scorer outputs and revision history remain coordinator side.
history: Create-only hash-linked proposal/revision/trial/counterexample/freeze receipts identify proposer, reviser, deterministic selector and latent-oracle/scorer verifier. Every scheduled case remains in denominators.
recovery: Immutable OperationsStore job/request keys and per-case receipts prevent repeated execution; terminal result reloads verified bytes. Unacknowledged prior CPU attempts remain failed/unknown-cost observations rather than being silently rerun.
model_origin_rule: Reject MODEL_PROPOSED/MODEL_REVISED without identified actual native proposal and qualification evidence; even hashed status records cannot enable an unregistered native-proposal adapter in this supplied CPU milestone.

validation.evidence_scope: Temporary CPU public-worker lifecycle, corruption/restart/idempotency/proposal-origin controls; no native model execution
